decisions.reason: The Remarks bullet made relative-phase change universal, although H_op=E I gives U(t)=exp(-iEt/hbar) I and fixes every ray. This nonfatal explanatory overstatement did not invalidate Definition (a)-(g). Defined relative phase for nonzero coefficients in a fixed orthonormal basis and stated the scalar-Hamiltonian exception. Definition, choice hypotheses, units and physical_scope are unchanged.

Functions constant on the fixed three-set partition cannot uniformly approximate arbitrary bounded Borel functions on R. The correct formula follows immediately from the cited star-homomorphism theorem (4): g=f(E1)1_{E1}+f(E2)1_{E2} agrees with f almost everywhere for every scalar spectral measure, and g_n=g is uniformly bounded. Replaced that local proof gap, verified the regular finite-atomic PVM/full integral domain, corrected the F7 citation, and proved rotation and squared norm by Cartesian algebra including zero coefficients. Claims (i)-(vi) and physical_scope are unchanged; the owned contract was synchronized under the shared lock.

The summary omitted distinct eigenvalues: distinct eigenrays in one eigenspace have stationary nonzero superpositions. This is a nonfatal explanatory qualification, since the described counterexample already assumes E1 unequal E2. Corrected both summaries to distinct eigenvalues and added the common-eigenvalue exception using finite-superposition clause (i) and stationary-state theorem (c). The counterexample and physical_scope remain unchanged.
